project.name: Demo Taskboard
project.summary: Next.js calendar and task-board demo with Hono OpenAPI routes, Drizzle PostgreSQL persistence, i18n, and a React calendar UI.
goals: Provide the demo web application, calendar UI, and event CRUD API.
Own the Drizzle event schema, Hono OpenAPI route handlers, Next.js pages, i18n routing, and frontend event workflow.
Keep database migrations, environment configuration, and API/UI behavior coherent for the demo deployment.
nonGoals: Own the mobile calendar client, enterprise doctrine, generic scheduling platform semantics, or shared foundation packages.
Own customer-specific workflows outside this demo app.
Own reusable scheduling contracts until they are promoted into a dedicated shared package or service.

owns.name: demo-taskboard-web-app
owns.description: The Next.js application, localized calendar page, UI components, and app-level provider wiring for the taskboard demo.

owns.name: demo-taskboard-event-api
owns.description: The Hono OpenAPI /api/events routes, Drizzle event schema, database access, and environment contract for demo event CRUD.

doesNotOwn: The mobile calendar client in EpiowAI/demo-calendar-mobile.
Enterprise engineering doctrine and manifest schema owned by SylphxAI/doctrine.
Reusable scheduling platform semantics, shared foundation packages, or customer-specific workflows outside this demo.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema and engineering doctrine

forbiddenCouplings: Do not put mobile-client-specific behavior into the web application API unless it is part of the documented event API contract.
Do not turn demo-only event semantics into a shared scheduling platform contract without moving that contract to an owning shared repo or service.
Do not fork doctrine standards into this repository.

delivery.deployPath: No repo-local GitHub CI or deployment workflow is present. The demo app is built with Next.js and requires DATABASE_URL for Drizzle-backed deployment.
delivery.productionProof: Biome check, bun test, Next build, Drizzle migration validation, and deployment readback from the documented hosting environment.

gaps.description: The repository has package validation scripts but no GitHub PR or merge_group CI workflow recorded at this baseline.
The repository has an environment example but no README or runbook documenting deployment, migration replay, smoke checks, or rollback.
